climate: Seasons this mild ripen Pinot Gris, Sauvignon Blanc, Müller-Thurgau, Gewürztraminer and Riesling fully without cooking off their freshness.
Pinot Gris and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Syrah is at its cool limit. In cool years it can stay underripe, with green, sharp flavors.
Summers are close to rainless. Vines need irrigation or deep soil that stores winter rain, but disease is rare.

soil.rock: Volcanic rock is porous, so it drains well and sends roots deep. Lava soils are mostly basalt, rich in iron, calcium and magnesium.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.
